Test a per‑horizon weighted mean using the top‑k‑mean‑per‑horizon handle w6 on the full pool to capture horizon‑specific best models.
Test a robust DBA combination on the top‑5 pool to see if a constrained optimization over a small, diverse set improves over the current weighted top‑k mean.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w6' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.949. Series context: trend strength 0.9979 and seasonal strength 1.0; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.014); 1 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.222.
